title: Submitted material
emptyHelp: Nothing has been submitted with this status.
noFiles: No files were attached. This is a description-only report.
linkHelp: Links are set only by you; nothing is matched automatically.
catalogHelp: Each item is created as a draft, hidden from everyone outside the archive team. The files move out of staging into the archive.
singleItem: Put all files into one item
catalogDefaults: Items start as institution-only drafts whatever the submitter hoped for; access is decided when the authorization letter is signed.
rejectNoteRequired: A reason is required to reject.
rejectWarning: The uploaded files are deleted immediately. The record and this reason are kept.
